name: CG-only inference + CFG-trained head (dead code)
tagline: Trains a return-conditioned diffusion head and CumRew classifier; at inference only CG is actually applied — agent.sample omits condition_cfg/w_cfg, so the listed CFG hyperparameters are unused.

key_hyperparams.name: label_dropout
key_hyperparams.role: CFG dropout for the return token (only used at training)

key_hyperparams.name: w_cfg (hardcoded but unused)
key_hyperparams.role: computed locally, NEVER passed into agent.sample — no inference effect

key_hyperparams.name: w_cg
key_hyperparams.role: CG strength actually applied at sampling

key_hyperparams.name: target_return_scale (unused)
key_hyperparams.role: computed but no condition_cfg ever reaches the sampler

diff_from_baseline: Adds CFG TRAINING (MLPCondition with label-dropout) on top of the default CG baseline, but the inference call only passes `w_cg=args.task.w_cg` to `agent.sample` — no `condition_cfg` or `w_cfg` argument is forwarded, so CFG defaults to w_cfg=0 and condition_cfg=None inside DiscreteDiffusionSDE.sample. The hardcoded HYBRID_W_CFG / HYBRID_TARGET_RETURN dicts and `hybrid_w_cfg / hybrid_target_return` locals are computed but never referenced.

name: CFG+CG diffuser with rescaled w_cg
tagline: CFG-style return-conditioning + CG classifier active simultaneously, with the CG weight implicitly multiplied by the return scale.

key_hyperparams.name: w_cg_eff
key_hyperparams.role: rescaled to match raw value head

diff_from_baseline: Adds CFG conditioning on top of the default CG baseline (default has no MLPCondition); also normalises the classifier target by the env return scale and undoes the scaling on w_cg at sample time — neither cfg nor decision_diffuser baselines do this rescale.

name: HEDGE: RTG-tracked CFG + CG ensemble
tagline: Hybrid CFG + CG with online return-to-go tracking, candidate-spread sampling around the running RTG, and softmax-weighted action averaging across elite plans.
diff_from_baseline: Compared to the cfg baseline (single fixed return target, classifier=None) and decision_diffuser (state-only DiT, no CG), this keeps both CG and CFG and adds (i) online RTG bookkeeping, (ii) a return-spread bracket of candidates and (iii) softmax-weighted action averaging across the top-4 elite trajectories.

name: CG diffuser (default; no real change)
tagline: Essentially the default classifier-guided pipeline: MLPCondition is imported but never wired into the diffusion model.
diff_from_baseline: Practically identical to the `default` baseline: imports CFG primitives but never instantiates an MLPCondition, so the diffusion model is built with `None` condition net and only CG is active at inference; no algorithmic change vs. CG.

name: CG diffuser (default; near no-op)
tagline: Effectively reproduces the default CG baseline: no CFG conditioning, no candidate-selection change, only minor import shuffling.
diff_from_baseline: Matches the `default` baseline almost line for line: classifier guidance only, no MLPCondition is created, no inference-time changes; the only deltas are import reordering and an explicit MLPCondition import that is never used.
